message: PSCOPE-2-2 requires full DM prompt-target plumbing cleanup, but current committed code retains non-null DM-era onboarding fields (approver, prompt_conversation_jid, prompt_agent_folder, dismissed_at) through the domain, coordinator, and Postgres schema; the brief does not say whether to perform a schema migration/cutover or retain physical columns. Please resolve the intended cleanup boundary.

PSCOPE-2-3 does not specify which Discord channel receives the GUILD_CREATE manual-setup message when a guild has multiple channels or no system_channel_id; a deterministic destination/fallback rule is required.

notes: system_channel_id when present, otherwise SKIP the message entirely (never guess a channel; posting into an arbitrary channel is worse than silence). Record the onboarding row either way so reconnect refires stay quiet. Registration remains manual regardless - the message is best-effort guidance, not a gate.

Retain the physical columns: the bootstrap flow REUSES them (adder/approver hold the installer, the row is the dedup+claim record, dismissed_at participates in reclaim clearing). prompt_conversation_jid/prompt_agent_folder now carry bootstrap context (chat jid / account agent). No migration - dropping columns for naming aesthetics is churn without behavior; revisit only if the row shape ever changes for real reasons.
